result: 8 GiB Pi 4B raw-image candidate rebuilt with full-size RedSea /Home and /Tmp, bounded FileWrite create/replace, regular-file FileDel, DirMake, and two protected source banks. Image builder, Pi platform checks, and a disposable stock-RedSea delete/slot-reuse/cold-persistence probe passed. Physical microSD was not written.

zealos_data.contents: Full-size RedSea volume followed by two 32 MiB append-only source banks

checks: make pi-image completed successfully; builder verified the merged FAT32 payload by mtools read-back.
Builder verified MBR extents, RedSea geometry/root bitmap, /Home and /Tmp, and both source-bank headers.
scripts/check-pi-desktop-image.py passed native/recovery ELF, relocation, boot-chain and source-module checks.
make check-pi4-platform passed, including partition-bounded block I/O and fake SDHCI read/write/flush/read-back tests.

The stock RedSea disposable-image probe deleted EARLY.TXT, confirmed LATE.TXT remained readable/listed, reused the deleted directory slot for REUSED.TXT, cold-booted, and verified both remaining files persisted with zstatus failed=0.

The shared RedSea delete callback compiled into the Pi desktop payload; the Pi SDHCI and partition-bounded backend pass fake-controller/host checks. The RedSea probe used UTM VirtIO, not the physical Pi SDHCI path.
known_scope: Host-built image only; no physical microSD write, boot, card read-back, or cold-boot persistence test.
The runtime requires explicit psdopen before ordinary SD writes and deletes.
Physical Pi FileWrite/FileDel, card read-back, and cold-boot persistence are unverified.
Directory deletion, rename, directory growth, general writable USB storage, and a Pi-bootable USB installer are not included.
This candidate includes uncommitted source and documentation changes.
